text.en:
Containing 33,761 square meters.
Bounded on northeast and southeast by Iloilo Strait; on
southwest by Philippine Railway Company right of way;
on northwest by lot 1.
Bearings true. Declination, 1° 40' E.
Points referred to marked on plan In-113.
Surveyed, December 20, 1911. Approved, August 4, 1913.
[NOTE.- Lots 6720 and 6750, Iloilo Cadastral Case 2.]
W. CAMERON FORBES,
Governor-General.
